module: "Properties" window (fg_properties) of the Flowgraph editor: inspector of the selected node (or the current graph). It displays a colored header with custom renaming/colors, the node's specific properties (node:drawCustomProperties), its data table, its input pins (hardcoded value, templates, visibility) and output pins (current _value), and the graph properties (name, macro tags...). Each change adds a history entry via fgEditor.addHistory.
notes: _drawInputField handles number (float/int, input or slider depending on pin.numericSetup, min/max bounds applied), string and other types; the ImGui values are cached in item._cdata.
The local variable `previousNode` (file upvalue) is used to call showProperties/hideProperties on the previously selected node; self.previousNode (init) is not used afterwards.
Only the "single selected node" case displays the node properties.
The inputs are disabled (BeginDisabled) when mgr.allowEditing is false.
In _drawDataTable with keysEditable, the key rename callback calls saveCallback with v[k] already set to nil (nil value).

init.desc: Registers the window (visible by default) and loads the header texture art/imgui_node_header.png.

_drawInputField.desc: Draws an edit field suited to the value type and calls saveCallback when the input is validated.

enterOnly.desc: Validate only with Enter (inferred from the name).

_drawDataTable.desc: Draws a data table in two key/value columns (sorted keys), or a single row if the only key is 'value'.

customPropertyColor.desc: Draws an RGBA color picker for a custom property and writes it to item[customName] at the end of the edit.

initCustomProperties.desc: Prepares the name and color (customColor/color, iconColor) edit fields of an item.

drawItemHeader.desc: Draws the item's colored header with its name and the edit button (mode_edit) for the name and colors.

getFirstAllowedType.desc: Returns the first allowed type (alphabetical order) of a types table; 'number' if types is nil, 'bool' if none.

drawCustomInPins.desc: Draws the editable "Input Pins" section for nodes with custom input pins (allowCustomInPins).

drawCustomOutPins.desc: Draws the editable output pins section (allowCustomOutPins).

drawHardTemplates.desc: Draws the "..." combo offering hardcoded value templates for a pin (file selection if pin.allowFiles, path relative to the project folder).

drawInPins.desc: Draws the "Input Pins" section: visibility, type icon, name, hardcoded value or link.

drawOutPins.desc: Draws the "Output Pins" section: visibility (can be hidden if not linked), type, name and current value (pin._value).

drawItemProperties.desc: Draws the item's data table then its input and output pins (editable or not).

draw.desc: Draws the window: highlights the links of the selected nodes, handles selection changes, displays the selected node or the graph properties.

dt.desc: Real delta time (s), passed to node:drawCustomProperties.

unselect.desc: Calls hideProperties on the previously displayed node and resets the edit states. Called when the window closes.

showAvailableMacroTags.desc: Lists the project's macro tags (mgr.macroTags) with renaming and deletion.

drawGraphProperties.desc: Draws the properties of a graph (name, with update of the integrated node for a macro, etc.).
